caption:
One tiny word flips this verb.

"The number of students has doubled" (one total). "A number of students have joined" (several). Read "the number" as "the total."

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: The number of = singular. A number of = plural.

youtube.title: "The Number Of" vs. "A Number Of": SAT Agreement
youtube.description: "The number of" is one total and takes a singular verb; "a number of" means several and takes a plural verb.
